description.value: Uma Sushi is a traditional Japanese eatery in Vancouver's Cambie and Broadway neighbourhood, helmed by Chef Ma, who trained at Le Crocodile and the Art Institute of Vancouver. The restaurant focuses on authentic sushi and donburi bowls, with farm-to-table ingredients and carefully sourced fresh fish — including seasonal highlights like spot prawns and sanma. It operates as a casual, family-friendly spot with both dine-in and takeout available.
